title: Mitchell TTX · counterair sweep
subtitle: Three CCA approach axes, crewed follow-on, between-pulse pressure
description: 2024 Mitchell Institute tabletop-exercise concept (Figures 3-5): three axes of expendable counterair/EW CCA precede F-22/F-35 follow-on support; recoverable CCA and F-15EX maintain pressure between notional maritime strike pulses.
assumptions: TTX mission concept and participating platform roles derive from the February 2025 Mitchell Institute report, pages 15-18; this is a proposed wargame concept, not a real combat flight record.

The report specifies three axes and a 3:1 ratio of weapon-carrying to EW CCA for the advance sweep, but it does not publish precise tracks, positions, aircraft-by-aircraft numbers or event timestamps.
All map paths, geographic placement, icon spacing and playback seconds are editorial illustration, not operational trajectories or validated mission timing.
Figure 3 assumes two notional maritime strike pulses per day during the opening conflict stage; this playback does not simulate sortie outcomes or aircraft performance.

phases.title: Notional Maritime Strike Context
phases.narrative: The report's Figure 3 assumes two daily maritime strike pulses, each illustrated by eight standoff bombers, eight penetrating bombers, 16 F-35A and 16 F-15EX; these are planning assumptions, not observed sorties.

phases.title: Three Expendable CCA Axes
phases.narrative: Figure 4 describes three approach axes with a reported 3:1 mix of air-to-air-armed and EW expendable CCA; plotted directions are editorial, not disclosed tracks.

phases.title: Defense Reactions / Cues
phases.narrative: The TTX concept seeks to prompt defensive responses and reveal activity, without published observed engagement or targeting results.

phases.title: F-22 / F-35 Follow-On
phases.narrative: One CCA axis is followed by F-22s and F-35s, with target-cue concepts involving penetrating CCA and E-7A (Figure 4; p. 17).

phases.title: Maritime Strike-Pulse Support
phases.narrative: The sweep is planned in support of notional strikes on maritime targets in the Taiwan defense scenario; no actual attack path is reported.

phases.title: CCA-1 and F-15EX Pressure
phases.narrative: Figure 5 uses recoverable CCA-1 screening and ISR-supported F-15EX standoff elements to maintain pressure between pulses.

phases.title: Conceptual Next Pulse
phases.narrative: Figure 4 proposes varying the axes from pulse to pulse. No repeatable geometry or precise reconstitution timing is supplied.
